ext_name.message: X - Block all tweets from that country or region

ext_description.message: Detect the country or region of X accounts on your timeline (About this account).

pop_heading.message: X - Block all tweets from that country or region

a11y_toggle_lane_notinterested.message: Enable or disable Not interested lane

pop_mode_hint_block.message: Selected accounts are blocked on your X account. Their posts will no longer appear in any of your X apps: desktop, Android, iOS, or web.

pop_mode_hint_mute.message: Selected accounts are muted on your X account. Their posts will no longer appear in any of your X apps: desktop, Android, iOS, or web.

pop_mode_hint_notinterested.message: Posts from selected accounts are marked Not interested on your X account, so X will show you fewer of them across desktop, Android, iOS, and web.

pop_premium_subtitle.message: Enjoy the complete Premium suite inside X - Block all tweets from that country or region by Premium11.

pop_premium_gift_message.message: The extension developer has gifted you a lifetime Premium subscription (USD 29.99). Thank you for being a loyal user of X - Block all tweets from that country or region by Premium11.

pop_opt_show_country_labels.message: Show account country next to the username on feed, explore, and profiles

pop_opt_show_country_flags.message: Show account country flag next to the username on feed, explore, and profiles

pop_opt_show_country_note.message: Note: This extension only works when X.com reports country or region data for an account (About this account). X often does not expose that information, so even with this option enabled the country or region may not appear next to the username. These limits come from X.com, not from this extension.

a11y_toggle_show_country.message: Toggle country labels on the timeline

a11y_toggle_show_country_flags.message: Toggle country flags on the timeline

pop_opt_taller_columns_note.message: Makes the region, country, and managed-account lists about two to three times taller, and lets the whole popup scroll so the layout feels less cramped. Off by default.

pop_opt_geo_local_cache_what.message: 1. What it does: After a successful “About this account” lookup, saves that account’s country or region on this device so the extension can reuse it later without asking X again.

pop_opt_geo_local_cache_benefits.message: 2. Benefits when on: Fewer network calls, lower chance of rate limits, and faster country labels plus auto mute/block decisions for accounts you have already seen.

pop_opt_geo_local_cache_off.message: 3. If you turn it off: Every lookup hits X again — more rate-limit risk, slower labels, and higher data use whilst scrolling. Existing cache is kept on disk but unused until you turn this back on.

pop_opt_geo_local_cache_size.message: 4. Storage: Very light — about 100,000 users ≈ 10 MB, roughly the size of one modern MP3 on your PC. Only successful country/region hits are stored.

pop_opt_undo_on_list_click_what.message: 1. What it does: When on, clicking a managed account removes it from the list and undoes the action on X (unmute or unblock). When off, list clicks do not release accounts — they only show a tip to enable this option.

pop_opt_undo_on_list_click_how.message: 2. How it works: Opens a short-lived background tab to that profile, runs the same ⋯ menu flow used for mute/block, then closes the tab. Not interested entries are list-only on X (no reliable undo).

pop_opt_undo_on_list_click_benefits.message: 3. Benefits when on: One click both cleans the list and reverses mute/block on your X account.

pop_opt_undo_on_list_click_note.message: 4. Note: A background profile tab will open briefly so the extension can unmute/unblock. Off by default so accidental clicks cannot open tabs or reverse actions without you meaning to.

a11y_toggle_undo_on_list_click.message: Toggle undo on managed list click

pop_toast_undo_on_list_off.message: To automatically unmute, unblock, or clear Not interested when you click a managed account, turn on Undo on list click. You can enable it now or later in Settings.

a11y_managed_account_locked.message: Managed account (enable Undo on list click to release)

pop_toast_release_confirm.message: Release this account on X? If they still match an active country/region filter, the extension may act again unless you whitelist them.

pop_opt_show_action_toasts_what.message: 1. What it does: When the extension blocks, mutes, or marks a post Not interested, a short toast appears at the bottom of X with that account's name, @handle, and profile photo.

pop_opt_show_action_toasts_benefits.message: 2. Benefits when on: You can see each automatic action as it happens, with a 6-second countdown before the toast disappears.

pop_opt_show_action_toasts_off.message: 3. If you turn it off: Actions still run as usual; only the on-page toast is hidden. The toolbar badge flash still works.
